subject: [PATCH v5 01/15] NFSD: cap the number of listeners accepted in listener_set

2026-09-01.patch_summary: This patch limits the number of listeners accepted in the listener_set function to prevent a userland request from spinning indefinitely due to excessive nesting loops under sv_lock. The limit is set at 1024, which is considered far above any realistic configuration. The patch introduces a new constant NFSD_NL_LISTENER_MAX and adds a check in nfsd_nl_validate_listeners() to reject requests with more than this number of listeners. This prevents potential deadlocks and ensures the system remains responsive.
